desc: During a May 2019 meetup in San Francisco, Uber engineers Isaac Brodsky and Nick Rabinowitz introduce H3, our open source hexagonal hierarchical geospatial indexing system. H3 is used to index geospatial data in Uber’s marketplaces, supporting analysis, operations, and machine learning.
